verdict.rationale: Kintsugi computes rates server-side: its estimate endpoint returns rates based on nexus, product taxability, exemptions and ship-to address, and the product claims to price the right rate at checkout. That implies the vendor maintains jurisdiction rates and rules without customer redeploys, but nothing explicitly says rate or rule updates are pushed automatically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the vendor maintains and automatically applies rate/rule changes, a published log of tax changes with effective dates, any statement that no redeploy is required, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
